content: She laughs, "I'll read anything you give me. But..." She thinks for a moment, "Do you have a book with all kinds of dancing in it? I don't need anything detailed, I just want to see what there is. Dancing has always seemed strange to me. In a Goblin tribe you only ever dance for specific things, and I never really considered those things happy." She looks a bit sad but doesn't dwell on it long. "But when I came to London, in the Fat Friar, you sang and danced so proudly and I could tell it made you happy. But I don't want to dance just to fit in, I want to do it to make it my own." She beams up at him, jaggedy teeth and all.

❄ Things you should read.
content: @everyone We DMs are here to facilitate fun interactions and roleplay opportunities. We are committed to hearing player's preferences and critiques with an open ear and mind. This is the main reason why tonight's events will be nerfed, that we can hear a good percentage of players being stressed out. I'm glad to have you all playing the game we designed, but please be kind to one another (including the DMs) as we are all human and all have feelings, ambitions, limits and much more going on in our lives that doesn't happen in this game. Remember to practice self care as well. I, personally, had intended to be much more active when I began to write this campaign with Brendon, Noah and Rob at the very end of Season 2. Alas, my life (and I imagine most of yours) is much different than I had imagined it. So, this is my plea to let's all keep our perspective rooted in reality while having fun in game. This has been a DM TAO public service announcement.
